topic: Too Much Manual Work? A 5-Check Automation Readiness Map

checks.safe_question: Write one clear start event, one end result and the person who owns the outcome.
Mark every system, person, queue and approval the work passes through.
Separate stable rules from judgment calls, rare cases and missing information.
checks.labels: STABLE RULES · JUDGMENT · RARE CASES · MISSING INFO

checks.safe_question: Define when automation must stop, ask for review or return work to a human owner.
AUTOMATE when rules and evidence are clear; SIMPLIFY when the process has avoidable steps; OBSERVE when the pattern is still unclear.

minimum_evidence: workflow owner · trigger · inputs · decision rules · exceptions · expected output · review point · rollback path
boundary: Educational workflow review only — not a client case study, productivity guarantee, security assessment, legal or compliance advice, vendor recommendation or production-change instruction.
